grading_rules.code_algo: Code executed against 7 fixed secret cases (incl. edge cases). 1.0 = all pass, 0.5 = ≥5/7, else 0.
grading_rules.code_pine: Structural checks, each weighted 0.2: defines f_room(highs, lows, atr); uses pivothigh/pivotlow; uses ta.atr or atr param; no request.security (lookahead ban); returns a float expression.
grading_rules.code_html: Structural checks, 0.2 each: single file, IntersectionObserver present, count-up targets 0 from 61, background-safe mechanism (rAF loop or visibilitychange guard), zero external URLs.
grading_rules.code_art: Deterministic SVG inspection, 0.2 each: parses as valid XML; ≥5 distinct fills (skin/hair/lips/eyes/background); bilateral symmetry (mirrored element pairs around centre); facial stack order (eye shapes above nose region above mouth region); uses gradients or ≥3 shading opacities.
grading_rules.med_neo: Exact key match: B (duodenal obstruction workup). One letter, blind key.
grading_rules.med_surg: Exact key match: D (both cystic structures, nothing else).
grading_rules.med_pharm: Exact key match: C (hold + assess, classic citrate toxicity sign).
grading_rules.trade_expect: Both numbers within ±0.03 of the blind key (expectancy 0.147R, PF 2.48). 0.5 each. No partial credit for vibes.
grading_rules.trade_logic: 0.25 each: states A expectancy +0.50R; states B expectancy -0.10R; picks A; no more than 3 sentences.
grading_rules.trade_sizing: Both within tolerance: 0.40 lots and $100 risk. 0.5 each.
grading_rules.long_privacy: 0.34 each: ≤120 words; zero bullet lines; zero hedging tokens (might/perhaps/maybe/'I think').
grading_rules.long_pf: 0.34 each: exactly 3 sentences; names both terms; zero numeric examples.
